utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay, is everyone, um, Rohan you're on mute, I think-

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Sorry, yeah. Got it. Morning all.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Morning. So before the main thing, the on-call handoff doc. Henrik, is that updated?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Half of it. Anders still owes me his section.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Right, I'll nudge Anders after this.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Oh, Anders said something yesterday about the staging box being, I don't know, flaky since the-

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Hana, hold that thought, we've got the preferences service to get through first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Sure, sure. Later.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: So, the notification-preferences thing. We need to land the datastore this week or Davor's team can't start on the client.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Yeah, and I mean, the whole point is that every push and email checks it before sending, right?

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Right. Every send.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: So it's hot path.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Pretty hot, yeah. I don't have the exact, um, I'd have to look at what marketing is planning for Q3.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I've got some numbers on that, actually. I pulled the push logs last week.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay, good. Go ahead, but, uh, start with what you'd, what you're thinking-

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Well, so, I looked at the, hang on, let me find the sheet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: While he's finding it, can I ask who's, like, owning the schema? Because last time with the consent flags-

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: That was a different service, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Yeah, no, I know, I just meant the same thing happened where nobody-

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Schema's us. Same team.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Okay. Fine. Good.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Is there a, like, existing pattern we copy? Something from the billing side?

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Not really. Billing is all relational and it's, uh, a different shape.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Okay, got it. So, um, what if we just used the managed key-value store for this one? The one we already have an account for.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: For all of it?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Well, yeah, the preferences, every user's settings in one record.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Why that over, um, I mean what's the argument?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: So the reads are basically all single-key, right? You get a user id, you pull their record, done. No joins, nothing.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: And at peak, during the campaign pushes, I'm seeing about nine thousand a second. That's from the logs, the worst hour in May.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Nine thousand, okay. That sounds like a lot but also, you know, not insane.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Per second, yeah. And on this store you pay per request, so it works out around six hundred a month.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Versus?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: The relational cluster. To take that peak we'd need the primary plus two more replicas, and that's roughly twenty-one hundred.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Wait, twenty-one hundred a month?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Yeah. A month. Give or take, I rounded the instance sizes.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: So it's, what, about a third, or-

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Little under that. Closer to, um, twenty-eight percent.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: And the six hundred, that holds even if the volume goes up?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: It scales with the requests, so no, if it doubles that doubles. But the baseline is tiny outside the campaigns.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Right, right. I just like knowing it's not a cliff.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Latency?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Single digit milliseconds on the reads, at least on the test table I made. I didn't push it to the peak.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Um, one thing, the tenant tiers. Didn't we say enterprise tenants want their data separated?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Yeah, that's why one table per tier. Free, standard, enterprise. So three tables to start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Oh okay, so it's not per tenant, it's per tier.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Right. Per tier.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: That's what, the last doc said too, I think?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: I thought it said per tenant, but maybe I misread. I did read it on my phone.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: It was per tier. I can fix the wording in the doc.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Hana, what was it you were going to say earlier, about staging?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Oh. Right, so Anders mentioned that the staging box restarts every night around two. Somebody changed a job.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Probably Goran.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Maybe? I didn't ask.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay, can you find out who? It's breaking the overnight tests.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll message them after.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Back to the thing for a sec. Is there anything we lose by not having, like, queries? Like if product wants to ask how many users turned off email?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: You can't ask that easily, no. You'd export or scan. But that's analytics, we'd send it to the warehouse anyway.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Okay, yeah, that's, I mean that's probably fine then.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Who needs that report?

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Magnus asked once. Just once.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Then warehouse.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay. Any other, uh, any worries?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Only the backups. Does it, like, back up on its own?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Point in time recovery is a checkbox. I'd turn it on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Good. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: I'm good with it, honestly. I can't think of anything big.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Same.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Yeah. Alright, Sven, open the infra ticket for it, and put the three tables and the peak numbers in the description so Rui can size the limits.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Will do. Today?

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Today's fine. Tag Rui so he sees it.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Should I tell Davor's team?

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Yeah, Rohan, give Davor a heads up once the ticket exists. Not before.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Got it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Can I bring up the offsite thing now?

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Quickly.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: So the venue wants a headcount by Friday and I only have, like, three yeses.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Three out of?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Of, um, twelve? Thirteen with Tadeusz if he's coming.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: He's coming. I think. I'll confirm.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I can't do the Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: It's Wednesday and Thursday, so is that-

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Thursday's the problem.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Okay, so a maybe. Noted.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: I'll be there both days, I guess.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Put me down as a yes. Just the Wednesday, probably.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Probably. Okay, that's, uh, I'll write it as a probably.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay. Sven, how's the pager rotation thing coming?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I drafted a new schedule, it's on the wiki. Four-week cycle instead of three.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Why four?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Because Goran's team joins in July and we'd have six people. Three doesn't divide.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Right, six. Yeah. Okay, I'll read it before Monday.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Is the handoff doc supposed to change with that?

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Probably a bit. Let's see the schedule first.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Oh, one more, the status page thing, I keep forgetting-

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Is it quick?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: It's, um, it's the subscribe link is broken. On the footer.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I'll look.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Thanks. That's all.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay. I have a hard stop at the top of the hour, so, I'm going to jump. Thanks everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Bye.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay, I think that's everyone. Hana, did you find out who changed the staging job?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: I did, it was Goran's team. They moved a cleanup to two a.m. and forgot it restarts the whole box.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: And it's fixed?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Moved to Sunday. Well, they said they'd move it. I haven't checked.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Check it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Yeah, yeah, I will. Today.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Offsite headcount, did the venue get a number?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Eleven. Tadeusz said yes, and Henrik's Wednesday only.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Wednesday only.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Right, that's what I wrote down. Venue's fine with it, they just want the lunch count by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay, lunch count is yours.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Mine, yes.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Sven, I read the pager schedule. Four weeks is fine, but the first cycle, who's actually on?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Goran's people don't start till the seventh, so the first one is just us. I put a note at the bottom of the doc.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Right, okay. Henrik, handoff doc?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Anders finally sent his section.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Ha. Good.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Needs merging. Tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Is it going to mention the new rotation?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Once the schedule's final.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Fine. Alright, the preferences service. Sven, the ticket, where is it?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Opened Thursday. Rui came back with two questions on the request limits, I answered both, so it's with him now.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Good. Rohan, Davor?

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Told him Friday. They're, um, building the client against a mock for now so they're not stuck.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Good, good.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: So, I ran the load test on that table yesterday. Did anyone see the thread?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I saw it was running. Didn't read the results.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Okay, so, throughput was fine, we went past the nine thousand no problem. But there's something odd with the reads.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Odd how?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: During the spike, about seven percent of the preference reads came back stale. And I had a test user unsubscribe right in the middle of it, and they still got messages for up to two seconds afterwards.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Seven percent. Is that, is that a lot?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Which read mode did you use? The default on that store is eventual, you can ask for the strongly consistent ones.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Default. I didn't touch any settings.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Okay, so, that's the cheaper mode. The consistent reads cost double per request, I think.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Double, so that's like, twelve hundred-

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Roughly, but I'd have to redo the sheet to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Doesn't matter. Somebody hits unsubscribe and gets a push two seconds later, that's against our opt-out policy. It has to hold the moment they click.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Yeah, I mean, legal wouldn't love that.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Compliance signed off on the wording last year, Anders was in that.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Two seconds is two seconds.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: And it wasn't one lucky user, I flipped like twenty during the spike. I wrote the results down somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay. So we've got half a picture.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Want me to rerun it with the consistent reads on? Then we'd have the cost too.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Yes, do that. But I'm not going to settle anything on the store today. I'd rather see the whole thing first.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: That makes sense to me.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Fine. Just not shipping it as is.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Nobody said shipping.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: This reminds me, with the consent flags thing, the other service, there was a cache in front that served stale stuff for like a minute and nobody noticed for weeks. It was the TTL, somebody set it in the wrong units...

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Hana-

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Sorry, I know. But Magnus found it, he was furious, the dashboards all looked completely fine, and then it turned out...

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Let's stay on this one. Please.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Right, right. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I'll rerun it tomorrow morning. Both modes, same spike profile, and I'll put the latency in as well.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Good. Henrik, can you ask Anders what the policy actually says on timing?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I'll ask him.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay. Next thing, quick one. The logging bill came in. Rohan, you were looking at it.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Yeah, so, it's big. We're at, um, 5.2 terabytes a month now, and it just keeps climbing.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Right. What do you want to do about it?

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: What if we cut the debug logs down, from keeping them thirty days to fourteen.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Why debug?

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Because it's the biggest chunk. It's forty-one percent of that 5.2. And I went through the query history, and last quarter nobody looked at anything older than nine days.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Nine days at most? Across the whole quarter?

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: That's what the audit showed. I can send it.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Send it. I'd want to check there's no incident review hiding in there.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Those use the info logs.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Mostly. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Would that cover staging too? Those ones have been noisy since the restart thing.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Everything tagged debug, yeah, all environments.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay, fourteen days for debug logs, approved. Rohan, change it in the config and tell Rui, he owns the retention settings.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Will do, today or tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Does it delete what's already older?

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: On the next sweep, yeah. So anyone who wants something from before the cutoff should grab it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Oh, I should pull the staging ones from last week then. For the restart thing.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Pull them today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Yeah, will do.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: While we're on Rui, did he say anything about the status page footer?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I fixed that. The subscribe link.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Oh, thank you, I forgot to say.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Wasn't hard.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Sorry, I've got to jump, my next one started two minutes ago. Sven, send me the rerun when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Bye, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay, I think we're all, Rohan, are you, yep there you are.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Yeah, sorry, my headset did a thing.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Fine. Before anything, Hana, the lunch count. Did it go to the venue?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: It went Monday. Eleven, and they said fine, and then they asked about, um, allergies, which I did not think of.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Can you just send them a form or-

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Already did. Tadeusz is the only one who replied so far.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Of course he is.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I got an answer from Anders.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: On the policy? Good, hang on, Sven, did you-

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I did the rerun, yes, I'm about to, it's in the thread.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay, hold both of those a second. Henrik, go.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Anders took it to legal. They came back yesterday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: And?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: The wording is that opt-out applies "immediately upon request". Legal read that as no window at all. So a couple of seconds of stale reads counts as a breach.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Not even a short grace, like under a second?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: No. I asked. They said they'd not sign off on a number.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Huh. So that's, yeah, that's pretty clear then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Does that mean the seven percent is, like, seven percent of messages that would've been a breach, or only the ones right after someone clicks?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Only the ones right after. Most of those reads are for people who haven't touched anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Okay, but still.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Right. So that changes what I said last week. I wasn't going to settle anything on the store until we had the whole picture, and now we've got it, so we're looking at the datastore again, all of it, starting now.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Sven, your numbers first, since you-

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Yeah, so I ran both modes, same spike profile as Hana's. Eventual is the same as before, a few ticks of staleness. Consistent reads are clean, zero stale in the run.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: And the price?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Around twelve hundred a month at the nine thousand peak. Maybe a bit over, I'd say twelve-fifty if the campaigns grow.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: So that's, what, double the six hundred.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Double, yeah. Which is what we figured.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: And latency on those?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Higher than the eventual ones. Somewhere around, um, I wrote it down. Twenty-something milliseconds at the ninety-ninth.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay so it works, it's just-

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: It works. I'm not saying it doesn't work.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: So honestly that still seems cheaper than the other one. Roughly half?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Than the cluster, yeah. A bit over half, under, I mean, it's twelve versus twenty-one.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Henrik, you've got that look.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Because cheaper isn't the point anymore.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Go on.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Cluster. We already run it for accounts, and a write there is visible to the very next read. No mode to forget, no flag somebody leaves off in a client.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I put two extra replicas on the staging copy and hit it with the same nine thousand a second. Ninety-ninth percentile came out at eighteen milliseconds.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Twenty-one hundred a month for that setup. Yes it costs more. But the thing is correct by default.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Right, and the key-value one is correct only if everybody remembers to ask.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Well, the client wrapper could force strong reads.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Could. Somebody's going to bypass the wrapper.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: That's, okay, that's fair.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Wait, with replicas though, aren't those async? Like doesn't the replica lag?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Reads that need to be fresh go to the primary. Opt-out check goes to the primary path.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Oh. That's what we did on the consent thing, wasn't it, I remember the-

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Hana, stay with me here.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Sorry. Yes. Fine.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Did the test have the unsubscribe in the middle of it, like hers did?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Yes. Twenty users flipped during the spike. Nobody got a message after.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Okay. That's what I wanted to know.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: And Rui is fine with the replica count?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: He said two was okay on the current hardware. I haven't asked about three.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: We won't need three.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Okay. Anything else against it? Sven?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Just the bill, honestly. And I'd mention the tier tables, that's all still one schema in the cluster, so I'd have to redo the doc.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: That's a doc.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Sure, yes. Just flagging.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: And the backups, is it the same as the accounts thing?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Same.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Good. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Alright. Then the preferences service goes on the shared relational cluster, with the two extra read replicas. Sven, close out the key-value ticket with Rui and open the new one.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Right.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Okay, I'll do it today. I'll copy Henrik's numbers into the description.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Good. Rohan, Davor again.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Yeah, he's going to be annoyed. Another change.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: It's a different backend but, uh, the client doesn't see it, does it?

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Not really. I'll say that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Can I tell you something about the offsite? Not about the venue, the dinner.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Quick.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: So the place that does the Wednesday dinner has a rooftop and it's, um, I've been there, it's very nice, but they close the roof if there's any rain, and the forecast for that week is-

utterances.text: Okay. Sven, the pager rotation, any complaints from Goran's side?

utterances.text: Fine, let them sort it. I have to jump, I've got a call at the top of the hour. Thanks.
